source_title: Aamir Khan, wife Gauri Spratt celebrate first Karwa Chauth after July wedding. Watch
source_excerpt:
Actor Aamir Khan and Gauri celebrated their first Karwa Chauth at Anil and Sunita Kapoor's residence. The gathering marked their first observance of the festival since their July 2026 wedding.
Actor Aamir Khan and his wife, Gauri Spratt, celebrated their first Karwa Chauth together after getting married in July this year. The couple was spotted at Anil Kapoor and Sunita Kapoor's residence on Thursday evening, where several members of the film fraternity gathered to celebrate the festival.
Aamir and Gauri arrived in traditional attire. While the actor wore a deep blue floral kurta paired with his signature harem pants, Gauri opted for a purple brocade sharara . The couple posed for the paparazzi outside the Kapoor residence before heading inside for the celebrations.
Several other celebrities also visited the Kapoor residence to mark Karwa Chauth. Among those spotted were Gauri Khan, Shilpa Shetty, Varun Dhawan , Maheep Kapoor, Bhavna Panday and Mira Kapoor, among others. From L-R: Chunky Panday with wife Bhavna Panday, Maheep Kapoor with husband Sanjay Kapoor (Photo: Yogen Shah)
Anil Kapoor and Sunita Kapoor's daughter, Sonam Kapoor , also made an appearance in a traditional Anarkali. Meanwhile, Anshula Kapoor, daughter of Boney Kapoor and sister of actor Arjun Kapoor, celebrated her first Karwa Chauth with husband Rohan Thakkar. The couple was also photographed together at the Kapoor residence. Sonam Kapoor (Photo: Yogen Shah) From L-R: Anshula Kapoor with husband Rohan Thakkar, Gauri Khan, Shilpa Shetty with husband Raj Kundra (Photo: Yogen Shah) For Aamir and Gauri, however, the evening marked a special milestone. The couple tied the knot in July 2026 in an intimate ceremony, making this their first Karwa Chauth as husband and wife. The wedding marked Aamir's third marriage.
